product.title: La Jolla Kayak and Snorkel Tour

description.text: Explore La Jolla's marine reserve with a guide on a combined kayak and snorkel adventure. Paddle past sea caves and kelp beds, then snorkel in protected coves to look for Garibaldi, rays, and other local marine life.

highlights: Kayak and snorkel in one guided outing.
Paddle near La Jolla sea caves and coastal cliffs.
Look for sea lions, leopard sharks, and colorful reef fish.
Small-group format with route and safety support.

start.description: Meeting location in La Jolla Shores, San Diego, CA. Arrive early for check-in and gear fitting.

faqs.question: Do I need prior kayaking or snorkeling experience?
faqs.answer: No, this experience is designed for beginners with guide support and safety instruction.

faqs.question: Is snorkel gear included?
faqs.answer: Yes, core snorkel and kayaking equipment is provided by the operator.

faqs.question: What wildlife is common?
faqs.answer: Guests frequently report sea lions, rays, and Garibaldi fish sightings.
